pk.context: 20 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

clues.kinetics: Absolute bioavailability is about 66% fasted at 20 mg, and food raises it. Protein binding is 92% to 95%, and clearance is mainly oxidation and hydrolysis, with unchanged drug also excreted in urine.
clues.substance: A pure single enantiomer of molecular weight 435.89, practically insoluble in water.
clues.product: Approved under an NDA, as 2.5, 10, 15 and 20 mg tablets and as granules for oral suspension.
clues.safety: Boxed warnings: premature stopping raises thrombotic risk, and spinal or epidural hematoma. Contraindicated with active pathological bleeding or severe hypersensitivity; bleeding is the commonest reaction.
clues.indication: Reducing stroke risk in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation; treating and preventing deep vein and pulmonary clots; and cutting major cardiovascular events in coronary artery disease.
clues.mechanism: It selectively inhibits factor Xa without a cofactor, reducing thrombin generation; it has no direct effect on platelets.

tell: It inhibits factor Xa without a cofactor, and its 20 mg tablet is a dark red triangle.

evidence.pk.tmaxH: The maximum concentrations (C max ) of rivaroxaban appear 2 to 4 hours after tablet intake
evidence.pk.halfLifeH: The terminal elimination half-life of rivaroxaban is 5 to 9 hours in healthy subjects aged 20 to 45 years
evidence.pill: 20 mg tablets: Triangle-shaped, dark red, and film-coated
clues.kinetics: XARELTO 20 mg administered in the fasted state has an absolute bioavailability of approximately 66%
Coadministration of XARELTO with food increases the bioavailability of the 20 mg dose
Protein binding of rivaroxaban in human plasma is approximately 92% to 95%
Oxidative degradation catalyzed by CYP3A4/5 and CYP2J2 and hydrolysis are the major sites of biotransformation
Unchanged drug is excreted into urine
clues.substance: practically insoluble in water and aqueous media
clues.product: Each XARELTO tablet contains 2.5 mg, 10 mg, 15 mg, or 20 mg of rivaroxaban
XARELTO for oral suspension is supplied as granules in bottles
clues.safety: Premature discontinuation of any oral anticoagulant, including XARELTO, increases the risk of thrombotic events
The most common adverse reactions with XARELTO were bleeding complications
clues.indication: to reduce risk of stroke and systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation
for treatment of deep vein thrombosis (DVT)
to reduce the risk of major cardiovascular events in patients with coronary artery disease (CAD)
clues.mechanism: XARELTO is a selective inhibitor of FXa. It does not require a cofactor
By inhibiting FXa, rivaroxaban decreases thrombin generation
Rivaroxaban has no direct effect on platelet aggregation
